description: Detect feature flag patterns in a TypeScript/JavaScript project. Identifies environment variable flags (process.env.FEATURE_*), SDK calls from common providers, and config object patterns. Returns flag locations, detection confidence, and cross-reference with dead code findings. `retirement: true` adds advisory retirement rows (reasons, git age, evidence).

allow_remote_extends.description:
Allow trusted HTTPS config `extends` for this request. Defaults to false
and never grants process-global trust.

config.description: Path to a fallow config file.

flag_age.description: Flag age: "blame" (default, lower bound), "pickaxe" or "off". Needs `retirement`.

flag_state.description: Offline vendor flag export for the vendor reasons; relative to `root`. Needs `retirement`.

production.description: Only analyze production code (excludes tests, stories, dev files).

retirement.description: Add the `retirement` block: one row per flag with reasons, git age and evidence.

root.description: Project root; defaults to the working directory.

threads.description: Parser thread count; defaults to CPU cores.

top.description: Show only the top N flags.

workspace.description: Workspace packages to analyze: name or repo-relative path, comma-separated list, globs, `!` negation.

name: feature_flags
